key_facts: By February 2026, Anthropic traced more than 3.4 million exchanges with its models to Moonshot AI, routed through hundreds of fake accounts.
Anthropic told the Senate Banking Committee in June that Alibaba's Qwen lab had conducted the "largest known distillation attack" against it to date.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent threatened sanctions against Chinese labs found to have built models on theft, citing watermarks of U.S. LLMs found on Chinese models.
The National AI Research Resource Task Force estimated the cost of its full implementation at $2.6 billion over six years.
White House science advisor Michael Kratsios said Moonshot AI built a platform to copy Anthropic's Fable model while evading detection.
